description: Non-material amendment to planning permission 2023/2371 (as amended by 2025/2552) to vary the timing of Condition 51 (Energy Strategy), Condition 52 (Embodied Carbon), Condition 53 (Circular Economy), Condition 54 (Mechanical Ventilation with Heat Recover) and Condition 60 (BREEAM).
